//: Alert rules as code for the private Splanc business folder (docs/design/ops-grafana.md). sync.py turns each into Grafana alert provisioning JSON: queries A[,B] on Loki (grafanacloud-logs), reduced to their last value, then `condition` (a math expression over $A/$B) or `$A > above`. `$env` becomes `alert_env` (a regex). Rules route through the DEFAULT notification policy; the owner configures its contact point. Every event and field named here is checked against agent/relay/src/ops.ts by agent/tests/ops.test.ts.

rules.title: AI credits: Anthropic org spend at 80 % of the monthly limit

queries.A: max(max_over_time({service="splanc-relay", component="ai-billing", env=~"$env", event="ai_settled"} | json | unwrap org_fraction [15m]))

rules.summary: Month-to-date Anthropic spend is above 80 % of the org limit (the relay stops at 98 %). Raise the limit / usage tier or expect 'busy' answers.

rules.title: AI credits: stopped at the org spend limit
rules.summary: Users are getting 'Splanc AI credits are busy': the org spend limit is (nearly) reached.

rules.title: AI credits: Anthropic errors spiking
rules.summary: More than 5 Anthropic errors (4xx/5xx, unreachable, broken streams) in 10 minutes: rate limits or an Anthropic incident.

rules.title: AI credits: reconciliation mismatch
rules.summary: The daily reconciliation found a mismatch: usage billed vs Anthropic's cost beyond 2 %, or credited purchases vs store / Stripe transactions.

rules.title: AI credits: card dispute (chargeback) created
rules.summary: A card dispute was opened: respond in the Stripe dashboard before the deadline.

rules.title: AI credits: refunds spiking
rules.summary: More than 3 refunds / revocations / chargebacks in an hour.

rules.title: AI credits: an account was suspended for abuse
rules.summary: An account was suspended (Usage Policy / abuse). Check whether Anthropic needs telling.

rules.title: AI credits: written-off usage

queries.A: sum(sum_over_time({service="splanc-relay", component="ai-billing", env=~"$env", event="ai_settled"} | json | unwrap written_off [1d]))

rules.summary: More than 500 credits (US$5) a day of usage could not be debited (beyond the overdraft): check the reservation estimate.

rules.title: AI credits: web checkout / Stripe purchase problems
rules.summary: A paid Stripe checkout wasn't credited (rejected purchase), or checkout sessions can't be created.

rules.title: AI credits: Stripe webhook signatures failing
rules.summary: Webhook calls with bad signatures: a rotated signing secret, or someone probing the endpoint.

rules.title: AI credits: Apple consumption answer failed
rules.summary: A CONSUMPTION_REQUEST could not be answered (12-hour deadline; Apple retries the notification).

rules.title: Feedback: problem reports spiking (after a release?)
rules.summary: More than 5 AI problem reports in 6 hours and over 3x the 7-day average rate. Check the newest app / firmware release (User feedback dashboard: by app version).

rules.title: Demo relay: 429 spike
rules.summary: More than 30 rate-limited demo requests in 15 minutes (our limits or OpenRouter's free-model quota): a crowd, a scraper, or the daily free cap.

rules.title: Demo relay: free models unavailable
rules.summary: The demo relay answered 'models unavailable' more than 10 times in 15 minutes: every free model failed (OpenRouter outage or a revoked key).
